sql: SELECT MAX(p.price_per_unit) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Bakery'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Hail' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND so.placed_on < '2026-01-01'
SELECT MAX(p.price_per_unit) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Beverages'

SELECT e.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.customer_tier = 'enterprise' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-04-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-07-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Qassim' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND so.placed_on < '2026-01-01'

SELECT e.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2025-04-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.customer_tier = 'retail' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-04-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-07-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'card' AND paid_at >= '2024-01-01' AND paid_at < '2024-04-01'

SELECT p.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) - l.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_tier FROM sales_orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_tier ORDER BY CAST(SUM(l.quantity) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, c.customer_tier LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT cat.name AS name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)) DESC, cat.name) AS rn FROM sales_order_lines sol JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = sol.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY cat.id) WHERE rn = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Eastern Province'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.customer_tier = 'retail' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients WHERE customer_tier = 'retail'

SELECT o.channel FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit * (1 - oi.discount_percent / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id JOIN (SELECT l.order_id, SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) AS rev FROM sales_order_lines l GROUP BY l.order_id) r ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.order_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns rt JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.id = rt.order_item_id GROUP BY l.order_id) f ON f.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY SUM(r.rev - COALESCE(f.refund, 0)) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'bank_transfer' AND paid_at >= '2024-10-01' AND paid_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'missing_item' AND closed_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients WHERE customer_tier = 'retail'

SELECT cat.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) AS rev FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = l.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 > 0 AND h25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (h25 - h24) / h24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT ci.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN sales_orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN (SELECT l.order_id AS order_id, SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) AS rev FROM sales_order_lines l GROUP BY l.order_id) r ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.order_id AS order_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM returns rt JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.id = rt.order_item_id GROUP BY l.order_id) f ON f.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY SUM(r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0)) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Qassim' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-04-01'

SELECT r.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND ((o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-07-01') OR (o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-07-01')) GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END)) ASC, r.name LIMIT 1

SELECT o.channel FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit * (1 - oi.discount_percent / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales_orders WHERE status = 'pending'

SELECT cu.customer_tier FROM sales_orders o JOIN clients cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales_order_lines GROUP BY order_id) u ON u.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY cu.customer_tier ORDER BY AVG(u.units) DESC, cu.customer_tier LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n FROM shipments
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'account_manager' AND ci.name = 'Taif' ORDER BY e.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-04-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.placed_on >= '2025-04-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients WHERE customer_tier = 'wholesale'

SELECT cat.name FROM sales_order_lines sol JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = sol.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)) DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'account_manager' AND ci.name = 'Jubail' ORDER BY e.name
SELECT MAX(p.price_per_unit) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics'

SELECT p.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) - l.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT cat.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1

WITH t AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(h) AS a FROM t GROUP BY customer_id), oc AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales_orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca JOIN oc ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id WHERE ca.a > (SELECT AVG(h) FROM t) AND oc.n >= 6
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Tabuk'

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) END) AS r25 FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-10-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01')

SELECT cat.name FROM sales_order_lines oi JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit * (1 - oi.discount_percent / 100.0)) DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT cat.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1

SELECT price_per_unit AS unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0058'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND opened_at >= '2024-01-01' AND opened_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'damaged_item' AND closed_at IS NULL

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-07-01'

SELECT o.channel FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit * (1 - oi.discount_percent / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'low' AND opened_at >= '2024-07-01' AND opened_at < '2024-10-01'

SELECT substr(o.placed_on,1,7) AS month FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS rc FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.placed_on,1,7) ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.rc),0) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Madinah'

SELECT ci.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2024-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND topic = 'account'
